LocationPickup.dc.html.title: Delivery details — Pick up at the shop

n1.text: One page for every way of getting an order. Delivery in Accra & nearby: the shop books a Yango or Bolt motorbike rider; the buyer pays the rider for delivery on arrival. Bus to other regions: the shop books the bus and contacts the buyer, who pays the bus fee before it's sent and collects at the station. Pick up at the shop: free, no map needed. Admin pickup points will be added to this list later. The map is the app's own map (tap Use my current location; no dragging) and shows only when the admin turns it on. Fourth board: KiyuMart's own riders switched on (fee paid in the app).

n2.text: Same names, icons and wording on every screen: Delivery details → Checkout → Order placed → Track order. Checkout shows how you get it with Change (back to Delivery details). Items are paid in the app; delivery is paid to the rider or bus as described.
